description:
A company's financial statements from its last several 10-Ks or 10-Qs, in one call.

For trends (revenue, margins, cash flow over years or quarters) instead of calling
get_financial_statements filing by filing. Returns each filing, newest first, with its
statements as that filing presents them (the same text get_financial_statements gives).
They are not combined into one table: a 10-K shows two or three years, so periods repeat
across filings (the newest filing's figure is current; it may restate), and labels, line
items and scale can differ between filings. Read the figures from each filing yourself.

Coverage: filings with XBRL, which the SEC phased in by company size: the largest companies
from mid-2009, other large companies from mid-2010, all others from mid-2011. Earlier reports
have no statements here (read a 10-K's Item 8 with get_filing_item); to have earlier years
added, email support@beatandraise.com.

Args:
    cik: Company CIK (use search_companies to find it)
    period: "annual" (10-K, or a foreign filer's 20-F / 40-F; default 5 filings, max 10) or
        "quarterly" (10-Q, default 8, max 20; foreign filers report quarters on 6-K, not covered)
    statements: Optional subset: "income_statement", "balance_sheet", "cash_flow",
        "equity", "comprehensive_income". Ask for fewer to get more filings in one answer.
    limit: Number of filings to read
    before: Only filings filed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD), for history as of a past date
    fiscal_year: Only filings for this fiscal year, as the company states it on the filing
        (fiscal, not calendar: Medtronic's fiscal 2018 runs May 2017 to April 2018)
    fiscal_period: With or without fiscal_year: "Q1", "Q2", "Q3" (a 10-Q) or "FY" (the annual
        report). There is no Q4 filing: the fourth quarter is in the annual report, as the
        year. E.g. fiscal_year=2018, fiscal_period="Q1" returns that one 10-Q; fiscal_year=2018
        with period="quarterly" returns its Q1-Q3. Each returned filing carries its
        fiscal_year and fiscal_period.
    include_tags: true to also get each statement as `lines`: every line with its XBRL tag
        (concept, axis members, unit) and its figures for the filing's own period (this
        quarter and year to date, or the balance sheet date), each with its value in full
        units, the text the page prints, a `ref` for check_citations and a `highlight_url`
        that opens the 10-K / 10-Q with that number marked. For building a spreadsheet model
        or citing figures: concept + members + unit identifies the same line in the next
        filing. Figures printed as a dash (zero) and filings before mid-2019 (no inline
        XBRL) have no ref or link; a filing's tags are added the night after it is filed
        (`tags_note` says why a statement has none). Responses are larger: ask for fewer
        statements or filings.
name: get_financial_history
title: Get Financial History
